# Assets · Motifs

3 files under `assets/Motifs/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for stripe-motif-chrome-yellow.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Brand shapes from the guidelines.

- `stripe-motif-chrome-yellow.svg` — ink #FFA601. 45° bars bleeding off a corner of dark covers (top-left and bottom-right).
- `stripe-motif-periwinkle.svg` — ink #8C9DFF. The same bars as used on the business card.
- `g-outline-motif.svg` — ink #8C9DFF outline of the wordmark's "g". Place at ~20% opacity, oversized and cropped, behind dark title slides.
